testcase.name: schema_bypass
testcase.failure: [MEDIUM] Server accepted message with missing required field: Removing field "action" from the message did not cause rejection, suggesting the server does not validate required fields. CWE: CWE-20 Fix: Implement strict schema validation for all incoming messages; reject messages with missing required fields. [MEDIUM] Server accepted message with wrong field type: Changing the type of field "action" did not cause rejection, suggesting weak type validation. CWE: CWE-20 Fix: Validate field types strictly; reject messages where field types don't match the expected schema. [LOW] Server accepts messages with unexpected extra fields: Adding unexpected fields (__admin, __debug, __internal_role) did not cause rejection. CWE: CWE-20 Fix: Reject messages containing unexpected fields; use strict schema validation with allowlisted field names.

testcase.name: origin_bypass
testcase.failure: [HIGH] Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH): Origin not validated: The server accepted a WebSocket connection with a spoofed Origin header. Connection with Origin 'https://evil.com' was accepted. An attacker could exploit this to connect from a malicious website. CWE: CWE-346 Fix: Validate the Origin header on WebSocket upgrade requests; reject connections from untrusted origins. [HIGH] Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH): Origin not validated: The server accepted a WebSocket connection with a spoofed Origin header. Connection with Origin 'https://attacker.example.com' was accepted. An attacker could exploit this to connect from a malicious website. CWE: CWE-346 Fix: Validate the Origin header on WebSocket upgrade requests; reject connections from untrusted origins. An attacker could exploit this to connect from a malicious website. CWE: CWE-346 Fix: Validate the Origin header on WebSocket upgrade requests; reject connections from untrusted origins.
